environment: Original isolated ForgeOS v12 KVM, Wine 11.14 win64, managed Windows x86 NSIS installation; existing normal authentication retained.

fixture.fixtureProgramPurpose: Read two bytes using DOS int21, add at emulated runtime, decimal-convert with AAM, print and write RESULT.TXT, close and exit. Synthetic program is input, not an accepted independent application.

limits: Only DOSBox 0.74-3 Windows x86 on Wine 11.14 win64, one small ASCII-path directory and a synthetic 181-byte DOS COM program are covered by this frozen original proof.

The synthetic program is a test input, not an independently accepted application. It reads two bytes with DOS int21, adds them in emulated CPU, converts to decimal with AAM, prints and writes a 32-byte result. GUI COPY creates a separate two-byte copy. Verification helpers only read outputs.
Directory mount, file copy, DOS program execution, result read, normal exit and explicit fresh-process remount/read were actually performed through the DOSBox window.

Chinese paths/input, non-ASCII DOS encodings, full-screen DOSBox mode, audio, joystick, graphics games, CD images, network, hardware compatibility, larger DOS programs and complete emulator acceptance are unverified.

Fixed main source declares GPL-2.0-or-later. Installed COPYING matches fixed source only after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Full SDL/SDL_net/zmbv and other bundled component license closure is unverified.
Installer archive listing, Authenticode, reproducible build, guest online download, new-machine registration, configuration migration and cross-version upgrades are unverified.
Independent market generation, cached same-version update, exact rollback and normal Core/Store restart were pending when the original proof was frozen.

correction.scope: Only the false two-backslashes source description is corrected; all original GUI jobs, fixtures, outputs, screenshots, definition and limitations remain unchanged.
